tenses.label: Present
tenses.description: Current habits, facts, and states. Begin with regular -ar, -er, and -ir endings.
tenses.example: Normalmente, hablo español con mi familia.
tenses.rule: For regular verbs, remove -ar, -er, or -ir and add the present ending.

tenses.label: Preterite
tenses.description: Present an event as a completed whole in the past. Use context to distinguish it from background or a habit.
tenses.example: Ayer, hablé español con mi familia.
tenses.rule: Regular -er and -ir verbs share the same preterite endings. Watch the written accents in yo and él/ella.

tenses.label: Imperfect
tenses.description: Describe past habits, background, or an action viewed as ongoing. It does not by itself say the action never ended.
tenses.example: Cuando era niño, hablaba español con mi familia.
tenses.rule: Regular -ar verbs use -aba; -er and -ir use -ía. Ser, ir, and ver have irregular imperfect forms.

tenses.label: Simple future
tenses.description: Practise the simple future for future events. Other constructions can also express the future in natural Spanish.
tenses.example: Mañana, hablaré español con mi familia.
tenses.rule: Add the ending to the full infinitive. Some common verbs use irregular stems such as tendr- and har-.

tenses.label: Present perfect
tenses.description: Haber in the present + a participle. Practise experiences and past events viewed from the present. Usage varies by region.
tenses.example: He hablado español con mi familia.
tenses.rule: Use he, has, ha, hemos, han + an unchanged participle. Learn irregular participles such as hecho, escrito, and abierto.
